# Supported capabilities

This inventory records the support status of public resource methods and CLI commands. `tested` means the listed behavior tests exist and must pass in the relevant test run; it does not assert every input or deployment has been tested. `implemented` has implementation without a dedicated behavior claim; `sdk` is delegated to the SDK; `internal` is plumbing; `unsupported` has no supported API workflow. Live database tests require the disposable database setup in the [testing guide](../contributing/testing.md).
